description.zh:
周期时间。

- 当CycleType为Month，返回1～28的数字，表示每月几号，用","拼接。
- 当CycleType为Week，返回1～7的数字，表示每周星期几，用","拼接。
description.en:
The time of the cycle.

- If CycleType is set to Month, specify the day of the month. Valid values: 1 to 28. Use commas (,) to separate multiple days.

- If CycleType is set to Week, specify the day of the week. Valid values: 1 to 7. Use commas (,) to separate multiple days.

description.zh:
周期类型。

- Month 每月
- Week 每周
description.en:
The cycle type. Valid values:

- Month

- Week

description.zh: 可维护时间段的结束时间。格式为[unk]hh:mmz-hh:mmz[unk]（utc时间）。
description.en: The end time of the maintenance window. Use the HH:mmZ format. The time is in UTC.
The start time of the task. The time must be in UTC and in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 是否生效 ,1 是 2 否
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the configuration. Valid values: 1 (Enable) and 2 (Disable).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-active-operation-maintain-conf --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cycle-type Week --cycle-time 1 --maintain-start-time 8:00Z --maintain-end-time 12:00Z --status 1 --comment test --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb ModifyActiveOperationMaintainConf --region cn-hangzhou --Status 1 --CycleTime 1 --Comment test --CycleType Week --MaintainEndTime '12:00Z' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-000000000000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --MaintainStartTime '8:00Z'
